disposition_reason: The results text prints concentration ranges of lead, cadmium and copper in branded packaged, dairy and vendor milk from Raiwind, Lahore; per-sample values and means are figure-only.

study.design: Market and farm survey of milk by source with THQ/HI risk assessment
study.origin: Raiwind, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan (sampling along Lahore-Raiwind Road, Raiwind-Kasur Road and Manga Road)
study.market: stores (branded 250 mL tetra packs), local raw milk vendors/shops, dairies
study.method: 2 g wet sample, HNO3 + H2O2 hot-plate digestion; AAS (Shimadzu)
study.lod_text: MDL Cd 0.003, Pb 0.001, Cu 0.005 (units not printed)
study.qa: Reference milk powder GBW10115 recoveries Cd 100.98, Pb 98.60, Cu 99.53%; spiked standards 99.2-100.1%
